name: livespec-overseer
description: Control-plane operator plugin for livespec. Exposes /livespec-overseer:overseer for the thin two-pane overseer surface, /livespec-overseer:supervise-plan for reviewed supervisor handoff creation, /livespec-overseer:foreman for the bounded foreman operator loop, /livespec-overseer:grooming for the bounded one-shot backlog drain pass, and /livespec-overseer:caam-anthropic-loop for caam-managed Claude Max quota watching and account rotation.
